problemsFound: Axe (WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A+AA) at 1280px: 16 of 214 crawled pages have serious/critical violations; rules: color-contrast x10, label x4, aria-prohibited-attr x2. All are on the sibling static sites (wida-access, esol, esol-reading-writing, language-adventures, language-studio); no lab (access-practice-lab) page has an axe violation.
Touch targets: 212 of 214 pages have interactive targets under 44px at 390px; 45 have targets under 24px (WCAG 2.2 AA minimum).
Focus indicator not visible after Tab on: search.

Core bank measured flags: generic-correct-feedback 8; hint-equals-support 85; answer-is-longest-clue 2; no-item-feedback 1; directions-long 41; no-hint 21; thin-vocabulary 18 (of 933). Feedback is already specific for choice/sort/order/cloze items; the weaknesses are hint repeated as support (85 constructed items), long directions (41), missing hints (21), thin vocabulary (18), generic correct feedback (8).

Static-server 404s observed on sibling sites: design-tokens.css (esol, esol-reading-writing, wida-access trainer) and /api/class/create (class-teacher; needs the Worker). Confirm against production before treating as defects.
Mobile length: a 3-5 listening sort activity renders ~6,700px tall at 390px (skill lesson, task card, word help and answer controls stack before the practice).
wida-access page meta descriptions call the practice 'Publisher-grade WIDA ACCESS ... prep'; check against the never-claim-official rule (hub body text carries disclaimers).
improvements: Added inventory.json: 162 families and 1,987 activity or route records with measured content flags.
Added Playwright crawler (tools/crawl.mjs): 390/768/1280 overflow, console errors, axe, touch targets, focus, minimal answer/feedback interaction; static server needs no build.
Added RUBRIC.md and rubric.json (A-K, weighted), tools/score-baseline.mjs and baseline-scores.json with per-score evidence.
Added tools/assemble-report.mjs producing REPORT.md sections A-O from fragments, tolerant of missing inputs.
unresolved: 15 untestable or count-only surfaces (see inventory.json untestable)
Baseline judged scores rest on sampled content (documented per score); measured scores are exhaustive over the cited files.
Early-band (K-3) interactions were driven with a pick-then-Check script; Speaking/recorder paths cannot be exercised headlessly.
